title: BackendContract
description: Response of `loxilb-appliance-backend contract-version --json`. The CLI validates this before any mutating appliance subcommand. Keys follow the same stability rules as the CommandResult envelope: always present, never null, secret material prohibited.

apiVersion.description: Backend contract version. The CLI refuses a major it does not know.

backendVersion.description: The backend implementation's own version string.

productRelease.description: The installed product release this backend shipped with.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the per-command JSON payload schemas this backend emits.

commands.description: Every subcommand this backend supports. A subcommand absent from this list is unavailable regardless of what the CLI build knows about.

readOnly.description: True when the subcommand changes no host state under any input.

capabilities.description: Feature markers within the subcommand (e.g. "json-output", "redaction"). The CLI requires a capability before exposing the dependent flag or behavior.
